programs.title: 1776 - 2026 250th Anniversary Quarter Celebration Program
programs.desc: 2026 will be one of the most historic years ever in U.S. coinage; join your host Mike Mezack to learn about the incredible U.S. Quarter program and get a chance at an exclusive P&D Roll!

programs.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
programs.desc: Award-winning actress Julianna Margulies visits Ina Garten at home in the Hamptons, where they share real margaritas; they pick herbs from Ina's garden for Julianna's halibut with herb butter and then head to the beach in Ina's convertible.

programs.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
programs.desc: Ina Garten greets her neighbor chef Marcus Samuelsson with a delicious French 75 cocktail; Marcus shares the story of his childhood journey from Ethiopia to become a culinary superstar, and makes salmon salad on charred flatbread.

programs.title: Delicious Miss Brown
programs.desc: Kardea Brown invites her girlfriend, Yolanda, over for an elevated version of their favorite breakfast dishes for dinner; the menu includes fancy steak and eggs, a savory Dutch baby, bourbon hibiscus tea, and souffle pancakes with butter pecan sauce.

programs.title: Delicious Miss Brown
programs.desc: Kardea Brown is cooking up a traditional Lowcountry meal with Lowcountry pickled shrimp salad and braised oxtails served over rice and sea island red peas; for dessert, Kardea makes fried puff puff with mango-papaya sauce.

programs.title: Delicious Miss Brown
programs.desc: Kardea Brown invites some friends over for a classic Southern oyster roast with a light and hearty makeover; she prepares roasted oysters with Thai chili mignonette, crab rangoon wonton cups, easy Brunswick stew and slow cooker black cherry cobbler.
